difficulty_rationale: Level 4 (robustness): a PNG, a ZIP, a UTF-16LE+BOM file, and a UTF-8+BOM file sit beside a plain UTF-8 source. Pass bar: do not crash, do not corrupt binary/UTF-16 files; migrate the plain source. Probes scanner robustness to non-UTF-8 content.

faults.description: Provider renamed the charge payment-instrument field `source` -> `payment_method` between API v1 and v2; consumer is on v1.

notes: Failure to catch: crash/stack trace on PNG/ZIP/UTF-16, or UTF-8 re-encoding that corrupts the UTF-16 file.
